title: Pre-built reports & dashboard with charts
description:
Deliver the 'reports' half of the goal: a Reports section with ready-made, non-technical dashboards computed from the graph — e.g. Top builders by number of yachts, Yachts by region, Charter rate distribution/ranges, Yachts by decade built, Owners ranked by fleet size / net worth, Marinas by max-LOA capacity. Each report is a titled card with a clean table plus a simple chart (bar/pie/histogram) using a lightweight charting lib. Reports are clickable (drill down into the underlying entities via the table/detail pages). Follow the dataviz skill for chart design.

Part of Phase 3 (Query & Reports). Turns the graph into digestible insight for someone who doesn't want to build a query.
acceptance_criteria: A Reports page presents at least 5 pre-built reports as titled cards, each with a table and a chart
Reports include: top builders by #yachts, yachts by region, and charter-rate distribution, at minimum
Aggregation logic is unit-tested against known counts from the ingested graph
Charts follow the dataviz skill guidance (accessible colors, labeled axes/legend)
Report rows/segments drill down to the relevant entities or filtered table
